name: tamagent
description: 에이전트의 작업 상태를 작은 도트 캐릭터로 보여 주는 Claude Code mod. 펫이 반응하고, 마감은 보스가 되고, 중계석이 해설한다

sources.title: External agent commands
sources.description: JSON array of argv arrays, for example [["python3","/path/agents.py"]]. Commands print an agent JSON array. No shell expansion.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: Agent source polling interval, 1–3600 seconds. Default: 5.

skin.title: Skin
skin.description: Skin folder name under ~/.local/share/tamagent/skins; default uses the bundled original characters.

characters.title: Character mapping
characters.description: Comma-separated agent=character pairs, for example claude=a, codex=b. Optional role keys: main, subagent, external, queue, unknown, boss.

language.title: Language
language.description: Panel language: auto follows LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG (Korean for ko*, otherwise English).

danger.title: Extra danger pattern
danger.description: Regular expression added to the built-in dangerous-command list (rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE, dd/mkfs, …). The pet only panics; nothing is blocked.

sportscaster.title: Sportscaster band
sportscaster.description: Play-by-play commentary above the prompt. /tama cast toggles it during a session.

casters.title: Commentator names
casters.description: Comma-separated commentator names, up to six, overriding the voice pack's names from the first. Leave a slot empty to keep that pack name.

sleepMinutes.title: Sleep after (minutes)
sleepMinutes.description: Minutes without tool calls or prompts before the pet falls asleep, 1–1440. Default: 10.

voices.title: Voice pack
voices.description: Commentary voice pack name under ~/.local/share/tamagent/voices/<name>.json; default uses the built-in caster and color commentator. /tama voice <name> switches for the session.
